basic_info.description: Nestled on a serene cul-de-sac, 1122 Elm Street is a charming two-bedroom, one-bathroom flat offering one of San Francisco's best values. This home perfectly balances tranquility with urban convenience, located just steps from Alamo Square Park and one block from Divisadero Street, where you'll find a vibrant array of cafes, restaurants, boutique shops, and markets.    The interior features high ceilings and hardwood floors, creating a spacious and inviting atmosphere. The updated kitchen and bathroom add modern touches to the home, while a small deck off the kitchen provides the perfect setting for alfresco dining. Outside, the shared backyard offers additional space to unwind, and the large, shared basement provides plenty of storage. Ample street parking is available in this peaceful neighborhood.    Other nearby conveniences include Trader Joe's, the Panhandle, and Golden Gate Park, making 1122 Elm Street a true hidden gem in the city.
